about: Mother of Learning mechanism readings from the 2026-11-18 batch (Luna over about 12,000-word chunks, unchecked), keyed by the existing mother_of_learning_powers row they match by name. Unmatched readings follow. The ledger itself is generated elsewhere and not edited here.

mol.power.absorption_cube.reading: Absorption cube (Zorian). Kind absorb-or-copy; The black cube draws certain incoming spells toward itself and absorbs them rather than being destroyed by them. trigger: An attack must be drawn onto the cube; the disintegration beam curves toward it, and a dark red orb is absorbed when thrown into its path. limit: It does not stop the cube itself from being redirected or knocked aside; Quatach-Ichl later targets Zorian with a spell that Zorian assumes the cubes cannot stop. interacts: It absorbs Quatach-Ichl’s disintegration beam and dark red soul-magic orb. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:058:p30]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: power-transfer.

mol.power.aegis.reading: aegis (Zorian). Kind other; It creates a dome of force around the caster, protecting them from attacks coming from any direction. Zorian’s dome withstands Alanic’s fireball. limit: The passage says a fireball should tax an aegis to its limit; this one held against a weak fireball. interacts: Protects against a fireball, unlike a regular shield, which the text says cannot stop one. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:004:p115]], named in 2 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.black_room.reading: Black Room (The group using the imperial orb). Kind time-loop; The modified Black Room dilates time: the group spends five months inside the imperial orb while only one day passes outside. trigger: The time dilation must be activated inside the imperial orb. limit: The group must remain inside the orb for the dilation period; the lines give the rate achieved but not its further limits. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:089:p223]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: time-loop.

mol.power.blood_magic.reading: Blood magic (Old morlocks; reportedly still practiced by some modern morlocks). Kind power-transfer; According to the reported account, a ritual killing of a person or animal provides power for spells. trigger: A person or animal is ritually killed. limit: The practice is banned in many places; the account of its mechanism is explicitly presented as what people think or say, not official information. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:013:p135]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: power-transfer.

mol.power.controller_marker.reading: Controller marker (A person marked by the Key, the Maker, or the Maker’s agents). Kind other; The marker identifies the Controller. Before the loop is activated, marking a new person invalidates the old Controller marker; once the loop is active, the Controller marker cannot be invoked and only lesser markers can be placed. trigger: The Key, Maker, or one of the Maker’s agents marks the person. limit: Only one Controller marker can be valid; it cannot be invoked inside the loop. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:053:p72]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.dispel.reading: Dispel (Zorian). Kind other; Zorian casts a dispel over the book, shredding the illusion that disguises its real title. trigger: Zorian casts it on the illusion-covered book. interacts: Removes the illusion covering the book. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:075:p36]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.divination.reading: Divination (Taiven). Kind other; Taiven uses a divination to locate Zorian, allowing her to find his room despite his not having told anyone where he moved. trigger: Taiven casts the divination and has a target to locate. limit: Taiven describes this use as pretty easy; no other limits are stated. interacts: It gets past the room’s rudimentary warding, which is described as covering basic detection and fire prevention rather than this kind of locating. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:012:p20]], named in 2 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.divine_blessing.reading: divine blessing (Quatach-Ichl). Kind other; A frame of divine energy encircles the recipient’s soul, enabling them to store and regenerate more mana without impairing their shaping skills. Quatach-Ichl says his blessing doubled his maximum mana reserves. trigger: It must be bestowed by a god, or, according to Quatach-Ichl, by an angel. limit: Angels are said to grant blessings only to their most pious and capable servants. interacts: It increases mana reserves without hurting shaping skills; classical magic has difficulty detecting it, but skilled necromancers can perceive it through soul perception. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:079:p146]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.domination.reading: Domination (A mind-magic caster). Kind other; The caster compels a target to carry out an explicit order against the target’s will. trigger: Whether it works depends on the target’s personality and circumstances; some orders, such as killing oneself or a loved one, are likely to be resisted. limit: The target knows they were targeted and is usually furious with the caster afterward. interacts: The target’s will and situation can make it impossible to affect them; unlike puppeteering, domination is described as an order-enforcing compulsion. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:035:p52]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.ectoplasmic_eye.reading: Ectoplasmic eye (Zorian). Kind other; A hovering eye lets Zorian see behind him while he looks ahead, allowing him to track the hydra and dodge without turning around. Processing both viewpoints at once depends on his mental abilities. trigger: The eye must be present, and Zorian must be able to process the two perspectives simultaneously. limit: Zorian is running low on mana during the chase. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:085:p6]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.empathy.reading: Empathy (Zorian). Kind other; Zorian senses other minds and receives basic information about them, including their thoughts’ complexity, species, and gender. He can also sense emotions, but complex or mixed feelings are difficult for him to interpret. trigger: The range is about ten meters when running in the background and much greater when he concentrates on scanning. limit: Crowds overwhelm his ability to distinguish individual minds and can cause a headache; interpreting emotions improves with practice and familiarity. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:015:p84]], named in 9 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.enhancement_ritual.reading: Enhancement ritual (A mage who undergoes the ritual). Kind other; The ritual uses transformation magic to give the user a lasting magical ability. A spell anchor made from the user’s mana reserves prevents the effect from decaying; blood magic can also tie it to life force, potentially passing the ability and an innate understanding of it to descendants. trigger: The mage must undergo the enhancement ritual; using blood magic for a bloodline effect requires cutting patterns into the flesh and stirring the life force into suitable structures. limit: Mana used as the anchor is permanently unavailable. The rituals can kill the user or permanently damage their magic if performed poorly; without blood magic, the user lacks the base creature’s instinctive affinity. interacts: Blood magic deepens the anchor from mana into life force and can transmit the ability and its innate understanding to descendants. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:087:p74]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.featherfall.reading: Featherfall (Zorian, after Taiven teaches it). Kind other; A spell that lets the caster survive high falls. trigger: The caster must be falling from a height. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:020:p49]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.force_lance.reading: force lance (Taiven; Zorian also uses it). Kind other; The spell focuses immense penetrating force on a tiny patch of a target, producing a fast, spear-like beam. It is designed to crack simple force barriers. trigger: The beam must be aimed at the target; it cannot home in on targets. limit: It can be dodged, and stronger, more advanced shields can withstand it. interacts: It is effective against simple force barriers, but not against some advanced shields. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:043:p14]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.gate.reading: Gate (Zorian). Kind other; Zorian opens a dimensional passage that lets people travel between separated locations, bypassing the patrols between them. He also opens one between the command room and the Ibasan base to let Zach pass through. trigger: Zorian must open the passage; the lines do not specify further conditions. shown by demonstrated [narrator [mother_of_learning:068:p6]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.ibasan_gate.reading: Ibasan gate (The Ibasans). Kind other; The gate acts as a spell-stabilization frame that keeps a portal created by someone else open indefinitely; it does not open a portal by itself. trigger: A portal must first be created by another means. limit: It cannot independently open dimensional passages. interacts: A soul might serve as a power source or improve the structure’s efficiency, but this is presented as speculation. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:064:p84]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.mage_sight.reading: Mage sight (Zach; cast on Zorian). Kind other; This experimental variation of mage sight filters out ambient magical noise so the viewer can see more important magical features, such as the Hole’s mana pillar. trigger: The spell is cast on the viewer and takes effect in their eyes. limit: The filtering is not terribly reliable. interacts: It addresses the problem that ordinary mage sight is overwhelmed by Cyoria’s ambient mana. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:008:p64]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.magic_missile.reading: Magic missile (Zorian and other mages). Kind other; A mage casts a missile spell and can add mana to increase its power, but only up to the point before the spell boundary becomes unstable. Zorian can also deliberately dial down its power; at low power its shine and opacity diminish, though it becomes correspondingly ineffective. trigger: The spell must be cast; increasing or reducing its power requires adjusting its mana or construction. limit: Its mana capacity is limited by spell-boundary stability. Zorian’s very low-power versions are barely effective, and deliberately weakening the spell is difficult. interacts: Magic missiles can be intercepted by shields and are stopped by Estin’s earth spheres and Chelik’s defenses in the tests described. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:020:p11]], named in 2 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.mana_sensing.reading: Mana sensing (Mages, including Zorian). Kind other; A mage can perceive mana around them and the flow of their own mana. Ambient mana can dull that perception, while a training ground warded to keep most ambient mana out makes sensing easier to practice. trigger: Practice is easier in a place with little ambient mana; Xvim recommends that Zorian train outside the city. limit: Ambient mana suffusing an area can dull the senses; the lines give no other limit. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:048:p115]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.memory_reading.reading: Memory reading (Zorian). Kind other; Zorian probes a person's memories by directing the probe toward questions he wants answered; the usefulness of the result depends on asking the right questions. A sufficiently forceful probe can overwhelm the target's mind and leave it an undecipherable mess. trigger: The target must be accessible to the probe, and Zorian must choose what information to look for. limit: A wrong question can yield worthless or misleading information. Pushing the probe too hard can collapse the target's mind and prevent further reading. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:039:p45]], named in 2 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.mind_blank.reading: mind blank (Xvim and Jornak). Kind other; A mind blank protects its holder’s mind from being read or tampered with. Jornak relies on it as protection against mental intrusion, but the apparent protection does not stop the force manipulating his perception and memories. trigger: The spell must be active; Jornak checks that his is still on. limit: It does not provide total protection against the manipulation Jornak experiences. interacts: It initially blocks Zach’s memory-reading spell on Xvim, but is absent by the time Zach later checks Xvim; it also fails to stop the force acting on Jornak. shown by character-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:021:p22]], named in 5 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.mind_blast.reading: mind blast (Psychics). Kind other; A simple telepathic attack that assaults a target’s mind; the lines identify it as a mind blast but do not detail its precise effect. limit: It is also the simplest telepathic attack to defend against. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:019:p24]], named in 2 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.mind_magic.reading: Mind magic (Zorian). Kind power-interaction; Zorian can influence susceptible creatures’ movements and emotions through mental manipulation. He redirects two thunder lizards’ heads so their electrical attacks hit each other, then intensifies their anger and urges them to fight. trigger: The target must be mentally susceptible; Zorian finds the lizards’ minds simple and their resistance low enough to manipulate. limit: He cannot control the lizards like puppets; he can only manipulate them enough to affect their actions. interacts: The invaders’ mind control of the lizards apparently leaves them less resistant to Zorian’s mental influence. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:012:p79]], named in 9 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: power-interaction.

mol.power.mind_reading.reading: mind reading (Zorian). Kind other; Zorian probes another person’s thoughts, letting him learn what they are thinking and use that information during the card game. Alcohol muddles the target’s thoughts and makes them harder for him to read. trigger: He directs mental probes at a target; muddied thoughts reduce their effectiveness. limit: Some hands remain unwinnable, and a drunk target becomes harder to read. interacts: The target’s increasing intoxication interferes with Zorian’s psychic probes. shown by demonstrated [narrator [mother_of_learning:029:p7]], named in 3 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.mind_sense.reading: mind sense (Zorian). Kind other; A psychic can sense nearby minds by opening their mind and taking in information; the ability to interpret information entering the mind is passive, rather than something he must separately activate. Zorian’s first successful sense showed minds around him as blazing suns. trigger: He has to open his mind; he finds it helps to concentrate inward rather than push his power outward. limit: At first the sense was shaky and required stillness and concentration; he later worked on sensing minds instantly while doing other things. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:019:p14]], named in 12 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.mind_shield.reading: Mind shield (Zorian). Kind other; A spell inscribed on Zorian’s medallion erects a barrier that protects his mind from telepathic attacks. trigger: Zorian must channel mana into the inscribed spell. limit: It can be battered down by sufficiently numerous or powerful attacks. interacts: It blocks the aranea’s initial mental attacks, but their repeated attacks eventually break it. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:033:p91]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.mind_spike.reading: mind spike (Aranea attackers, including Mind Like Fire). Kind other; A concentrated mental burst strikes one part of a target’s mental defense to crack or penetrate it. A defender with a responsive mind shell can detect the impact, repair damage, and reinforce the targeted area. trigger: The attacker concentrates the attack against a specific portion of the defense. limit: The passage gives no explicit cost; repeated attacks can strain a defender and create openings for probes. interacts: Designed to punch through mental barriers; Zorian’s mind shell withstands and repairs damage from individual spikes, but repeated attacks strain it. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:034:p135]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.north_finding.reading: North finding (Diviners with sufficient skill). Kind other; The practitioner uses shaping skill to locate magnetic north, eventually sensing its direction without a dummy compass. trigger: The practitioner must have sufficient skill to dispense with the compass. limit: Less-skilled practitioners use a dummy compass; no further limit is stated. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:012:p131]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.pocket_dimension.reading: Pocket dimension (Zorian). Kind other; A pocket dimension provides an interior space larger than its external container; a temporary one can also be used to store an object too large to fit in a pocket. trigger: The object must be placed in or accessed through the dimensional container. limit: The sphere is designed to capture and contain a creature; Zorian says its safeguards may not work properly on an aranea. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:076:p79]], named in 2 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.potion_of_self_awareness.reading: Potion of self-awareness (The drinker). Kind other; The potion makes it easier to block out distractions and focus inward, improving awareness of mana reserves and the soul. Zorian drinks it and experiences sharpened inward attention while the outside world feels harder to focus on. trigger: The potion must be drunk. limit: Its effects wear off; Kael is not certain it will help with Zorian’s task. interacts: Kael says it does not interfere with mind magic; Zorian suspects it offers no further clarity because his mind magic is already very good. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:052:p142]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.puppeteering.reading: Puppeteering (Zorian). Kind other; Zorian takes control of an Ibasan bodyguard’s body and makes him stab his commander, creating the appearance of betrayal and throwing the group into disarray. trigger: Zorian must be able to target the person; the lines do not state further conditions. shown by character-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:035:p52]], named in 2 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.self_illusions.reading: self-illusions (Members of the Perfect Phantasm Crafters; potentially humans trained in their techniques). Kind other; These inner techniques alter how the user perceives the world, such as highlighting things in vision or blocking sounds, while leaving most thoughts untouched. limit: The effects are described as easily undone; the techniques are considered relatively safe and inoffensive. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:065:p158]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.shifter_transformation.reading: shifter transformation (Shifters). Kind other; A shifter can transform quickly and safely, partially or fully, without material aids. The transformation also gives them instincts for using their alternate form and interpreting its senses. trigger: The shifter can transform at will and choose the extent of the transformation. interacts: Compared with potion or ritual transformations, it is faster, safer, and easier to use covertly; ordinary mages may struggle to move and interpret senses in an animal body. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:027:p66]], named in 3 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.simulacrum.reading: simulacrum (Zorian). Kind other; Zorian creates copies of himself that can act separately, such as being stationed in Koth or sent to conceal a plan. A simulacrum retains most of the original’s memories, but skills such as language are difficult to transfer back to the original. trigger: Zorian creates a simulacrum. limit: The lines do not explain the creation cost; language skills gained by a simulacrum are almost impossible to transfer to the original meaningfully. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:024:p202]], named in 10 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.soul_awareness.reading: soul awareness (Alanic). Kind other; A high degree of awareness of his own soul lets Alanic sense the spiritual sinkhole tugging at it when he enters its area of effect. trigger: He must be within the sinkhole’s area of effect and have sufficient soul awareness. limit: The sinkhole’s effect is weak, and the souls of living beings are too strongly tethered to their bodies to be pulled in by it. interacts: Lets him detect the soul trap without casting spells; Zorian has some soul awareness but not enough to notice it. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:049:p109]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.soul_meld.reading: Soul Meld (The lich (suspected)). Kind other; The book describes it as causing at least two target souls to merge and blend into one. Zorian and Kael theorize that the lich’s use of it was interrupted before completion, but they do not establish exactly what it did to Zorian. trigger: Requires at least two targets. limit: Used alone, it virtually always leaves the resulting entity insane or otherwise defective; the effect may be modified when used as part of a larger ritual. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:014:p170]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.soul_perception.reading: Soul perception (Zorian). Kind other; Zorian focuses this perception on a person or creature to determine whether it has a soul. He uses it to establish that both Silverlake-shaped figures have souls, though it cannot explain their relationship. trigger: Zorian focuses the perception on the target. limit: His control and interpretation are crude, and the perception is not sophisticated enough to unravel the mystery. interacts: It can rule out an illusion, remote-controlled puppet, or simulacrum in the first case, but does not identify the second figure’s true nature. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:024:p267]], named in 4 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.soulseizer_chrysanthemum.reading: Soulseizer chrysanthemum (The flower housed inside Mrva). Kind power-interaction; The flower attacks a target’s soul. Its housing amplifies and focuses the attack, extending its range and strength; in this instance it incapacitates Quatach-Ichl without drawing his soul into the flower. trigger: The flower must be awake and able to perceive a target; Mrva’s device can direct and amplify its attack. limit: The device consumes all of Mrva’s internal mana, leaving the golem unable to move or fight. The attack is not strong enough to seize Quatach-Ichl’s soul outright. interacts: It disrupts Quatach-Ichl’s control of his flight spell and leaves him stationary long enough for a follow-up attack. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:101:p207]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: power-interaction.

mol.power.sovereign_gate.reading: Sovereign Gate (The Sovereign Gate). Kind time-loop; According to Silverlake’s account of the travelers’ story, the Gate creates a miniature copy of the world and runs it at extreme temporal dilation. It also causes primordial prisons to attach to that world, rather than duplicating them. trigger: The passage describes this as the Gate’s effect on the world and its prisons. limit: Silverlake questions the cost and rationale, but no definite cost is established. interacts: It does not duplicate primordial prisons; it makes them exist in the recreated world as well as the original one. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:031:p92]], named in 3 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: time-loop.

mol.power.spectral_jaws.reading: Spectral jaws (Zach). Kind stand; Zach creates concealed magical constructs that manifest as spectral shark jaws and snap shut on attacking targets, cutting through the hydra’s scales and flesh. trigger: Zach casts the spell; the jaws spring into action when the hydra attacks within their reach. limit: The hydra can pull most heads free before they are bitten off; the jaws can later be destroyed or exhausted in battle. interacts: They intercept and injure the hydra’s attacking heads, overcoming its scales; a severed head cannot regenerate quickly enough to matter in the fight. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:067:p14]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.spell_of_recall.reading: Spell of recall (Aldwin Rofoltin; Zorian can cast it). Kind other; It is a two-part teleportation spell. The first part places a personal teleport beacon on an item and links the caster to it; the second later teleports the caster to that item’s location. trigger: The caster must first place the beacon on an item, then cast the recall spell later. limit: The passage gives no cost or failure limit; Zorian must learn and practice the spell. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:028:p72]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.spider_climb.reading: Spider climb (Zorian, after Taiven teaches it). Kind other; A spell that lets the caster cling to sheer walls and other stable surfaces. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:020:p49]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.suggestion.reading: Suggestion (A mind-magic caster). Kind other; The caster presents an order as something the target wants to do, attempting to shape the target’s perception of their own motivation. trigger: Whether it works depends on the target’s personality and circumstances. limit: The target does not automatically realize they have been affected; the passage gives no specific cost. interacts: The target’s will and circumstances can prevent it from working; it is described as subtler than domination. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:035:p52]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.suicide_rings.reading: Suicide rings (Zorian). Kind other; When activated, the rings release mana and cause an explosion of light and heat that kills Zorian. trigger: Zorian sends a pulse of mana into the rings. limit: Their activation is lethal to Zorian. interacts: Their activation results in Zorian waking at the start of the restart. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:033:p108]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.telekinesis.reading: telekinesis (Zorian). Kind other; Zorian uses telekinesis to lift a bicycle out of a creek, then uses magic to clean it. trigger: He places his hand over the bridge while using telekinesis. limit: The lines note that the magic uses mana, which Zorian’s simulacrums consider too costly for a frivolous task. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:091:p119]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.telepathic_relay.reading: Telepathic relay (Zorian; a matching pair can be held by another person). Kind other; The paired device lets someone touching one relay contact the person holding its matching pair telepathically, regardless of distance. trigger: One person touches a relay while the other holds its matching pair. limit: The passage gives no further limitations. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:033:p81]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.telepathic_relays.reading: Telepathic relays (Zorian; used by the aranea). Kind other; Stone discs act as telepathic relays, allowing aranea to coordinate their actions across large distances and letting Zorian contact the matriarch without descending into the sewers. trigger: The users communicate through the discs. limit: The discs are large and heavy, and the versions described last only two and a half months. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:022:p58]], named in 4 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.telepathy.reading: telepathy (Aranea; Zorian can also communicate with them telepathically). Kind other; The aranea communicate telepathically, but their telepathy is not language-independent: Zorian can understand it only as he learns their telepathic language. Their conversation is transmitted in a form he can receive mentally. trigger: Understanding aranean telepathic conversation requires knowing the language well enough. limit: Zorian is a beginner and can only grasp the general topic of conversations. shown by demonstrated [narrator [mother_of_learning:017:p28]], named in 8 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.teleport.reading: teleport (Princess). Kind other; Princess can teleport herself and Zorian out of the gelatinous dome, then appear next to the dragon. trigger: Princess curls up into a ball before disappearing. interacts: It lets them escape the dome that trapped them and evade the dragon’s charged attack. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:099:p147]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.teleport_rod.reading: Teleport rod (Zach). Kind other; The rod teleports whoever is holding it to the shelters when its programmed delay expires. trigger: A person must hold the rod until it activates; it is set to a 30-second delay. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:004:p100]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.transformation_potions.reading: Transformation potions (The potion drinker). Kind other; Drinking one transforms the user into a peregrine falcon, including a body capable of flight. The user must learn to control the unfamiliar body through practice. trigger: Drink the potion. limit: Control of the new body is difficult at first and requires practice; the potion eventually wears off. interacts: A non-humanoid form removes access to structured spells, though Zorian’s mental powers remain usable. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:061:p87]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.weather_shield.reading: Weather shield (Zorian). Kind other; It envelops Zorian and Kirielle in a shield that blocks rain. trigger: The shield must be cast around those it is to protect. limit: It remained effective for the length of their journey; no further limit is stated. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:039:p47]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

mol.power.well_of_souls.reading: Well of Souls (Sudomir). Kind other; The Well of Souls enables the attackers to gather souls without individually deploying thousands of soul containers and casting capture spells at each death. The gathered souls are being collected for Sudomir’s wraith bombs. trigger: The attackers have access to the Well of Souls; the passage does not explain its operation further. shown by deduced-by-character [character_claim [mother_of_learning:092:p132]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:001:p177]
unmatched.note: Academy rain barrier (Academy wards). Kind rule-imposing; A protective bubble around the academy stops rain from passing through it, while allowing Zorian’s hand to pass through its boundary. trigger: Rain encounters the barrier around academy grounds. limit: It stops rain only; it does not dry someone who passes through it. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:001:p177]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: concept-law.

unmatched.note: Academy teleportation wards (The Academy; commandeered by the invaders). Kind other; Zorian casts the spell to lift a bicycle out of a creek and move it onto a bridge. trigger: Zorian makes gestures and casts the spell on the object. limit: The bicycle’s weight and the height he must lift it make the task more demanding, though he can manage it. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:001:p166]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:008:p146]
unmatched.note: Levitation variations (Zorian). Kind other; Basic levitation uses repelling force from the mage’s palm. Advanced variations combine attractive and repelling forces, and require the mage to maintain or adjust multiple effects to control an object’s movement or position. trigger: The caster must shape the relevant forces; some variations require multitasking and earlier exercises. limit: The variations are progressively more difficult and are learned in a sequence. interacts: Pen spinning trains the caster to maintain two effects at once, helping with later variations. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:008:p146]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:040:p62]

If the authorization is sufficient, the door unlocks. trigger: The pass must be inserted, and its authorization must be high enough for that section. limit: Higher or more deeply restricted sections may require stronger authorization; the passage does not describe the limits of the system beyond that. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:040:p62]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: concept-law.

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:004:p127]

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:007:p117]
unmatched.note: lich's phylactery return and possession (A lich). Kind other; A lich tethers its soul to a phylactery. If its current body is destroyed, it returns to the phylactery and then possesses someone. trigger: The lich’s current form must be destroyed for it to snap back to the phylactery. limit: The lines do not state further limits. interacts: Zorian reasons that methods effective against a lich may also work against Zach and himself because they are soul entities under the loop. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:007:p117]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:095:p103]
unmatched.note: Lich resurrection point (Quatach-Ichl and liches like him). Kind other; A lich has a personal resurrection point, allowing it to take risks without dying permanently when its body is destroyed. trigger: The lich must be killed or otherwise suffer bodily destruction; the passage does not describe the precise process. interacts: It makes Quatach-Ichl unusually willing to take risks because death is not necessarily permanent for him. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:095:p103]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:078:p88]
unmatched.note: Lich’s soul defenses (Liches, including Quatach-Ichl). Kind power-interaction; They are made so sensitive that even a slight disturbance to the soul makes it snap back to the phylactery. Liches can adjust these defenses rapidly. trigger: A soul disturbance triggers the return; the defenses can be adjusted by the lich. limit: Returning to the phylactery costs the lich its body and whatever it carried; an experienced lich can take precautions against known tricks. interacts: They can thwart soul interference by returning the soul to the phylactery, but may be exploited by a soul-affecting object; a soul jar could instead capture the soul if the defenses did not prevent it. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:078:p88]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: power-interaction.

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:024:p193]
unmatched.note: Lich soul-link severing (Zorian, using Kael’s spell imbued in the silver disc). Kind other; The spell severs the magical connection between a lich’s soul and its body. The soul is then pulled back into its phylactery, banishing the lich without killing it; Zorian triggers it when the disc touches the lich. trigger: The enchanted disc must physically touch the target; contact with the target’s shields is not enough. limit: It does not kill the lich. The spell normally requires the caster to touch the target, and the disc’s operation was not guaranteed. interacts: It exploits a lich’s automatic return of its soul to its phylactery when the body-soul link is severed; the lich is unavailable while it prepares or obtains a replacement body. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:024:p193]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:004:p128]
unmatched.note: Lich’s soul mutilation (The lich). Kind conceptual; It can alter a soul so severely that it is mutilated beyond recognition, threatening a soul that might otherwise be reincarnated elsewhere. trigger: The lich begins chanting in an unfamiliar language; the spell strikes Zorian with pain and a sense of wrongness. interacts: The lich says it can defeat reincarnation by altering the soul before it gets there. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:004:p128]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: concept-law.

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:013:p30]
unmatched.note: List-search divination spell (Zorian). Kind other; A prepared list of search terms is connected by divination magic to a target book, allowing the user to search it for those terms. trigger: The user prepares a list of terms and chooses a target book. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:013:p30]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:050:p42]
unmatched.note: Living metal rounds (Eldemarian forces). Kind other; On impact, the rounds spread into silvery threads that wrap around a target. The living metal can take root in the ground and bind more firmly as the target struggles. trigger: The rounds must hit the target; the intended restraint becomes more effective once the metal roots into the ground. limit: The threads restricted the dragon’s movement but did not prevent it from escaping after an artillery strike left too few threads attached. The metal is described as morphic and malleable. interacts: The threads resisted the dragon’s dispelling wave and magical fields, and attacks did not appear to damage them or their damage healed. Restraint prevented the dragon from aiming its beam at the command area. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:050:p42]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:059:p94]
unmatched.note: magic-disrupting poison (Zorian uses it on Andoril Boranova). Kind power-interaction; The poison disrupts the victim’s magic, preventing Andoril from casting spells while its effect holds. trigger: The poison must be administered to the victim. limit: The lines do not say how long the effect lasts or whether it has other costs. interacts: It interferes with the victim’s ability to cast magic. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:059:p94]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: power-interaction.

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:028:p49]
unmatched.note: Magic-item use by a non-mage (Gurey). Kind other; A person need not be a proper mage to operate magic items: practice and specialized shaping exercises can let them use the items. Some commissioned items can draw power from ambient mana rather than the user’s reserves. trigger: The user needs practice and specialized shaping exercises; ambient-powered items require access to a mana well or ambient mana. limit: Ambient-powered items have severe drawbacks. Self-casting items are difficult to make; mana batteries leak and can explode if overcharged or poorly built. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:028:p49]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:007:p140]
unmatched.note: magic missile variants (Mages; Kyron demonstrates several variants, and Zorian practices them). Kind other; A force projectile can be shaped to smash a target, home in on it, pierce it, cut it, split into multiple missiles, or become invisible. Homing uses animation magic; invisibility comes from a perfectly constructed force-spell boundary without magical leakage. trigger: The mage must shape the spell; more complex forms require precise shaping, especially when cast quickly. limit: Multiple missiles require sufficient reserves and skill. Combat-speed casting and large mana inputs make imperfections likely; Zorian’s limited reserves also constrain sustained combat spellcasting. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:007:p140]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:049:p137]
unmatched.note: magic orb that translates thoughts to speech (Zorian). Kind other; The orb converts Zorian’s thoughts into spoken words so he can communicate through it. trigger: Zorian uses the orb to speak through it. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:049:p137]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:008:p56]
unmatched.note: Magical resistance (Every living creature; Zorian can control his). Kind other; A living creature’s innate magical resistance strains against foreign mana entering it. Zorian can deliberately reel in that resistance to let a spell take root unopposed. trigger: Zorian consciously allows the foreign spell through by reducing his resistance. interacts: His resistance initially opposes Zach’s spell; lowering it lets the spell work. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:008:p56]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:039:p110]
unmatched.note: Mana absorption cube (The cube; used by Kirielle for practice). Kind other; It absorbs mana that a user releases, and carved lines on its surface glow to indicate that mana has been absorbed. It can also be deliberately fed mana to help train control. trigger: The user must release mana into or toward the cube. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:039:p110]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:017:p101]
unmatched.note: Mana cloud sensing (Taiven; Zorian learns to use a version of it). Kind other; The mage expels mana to saturate the surrounding area, then senses the environment through the resulting cloud. It can reveal rudimentary information, including the presence of concentrated mana constructs; with practice, it can detect weaker mana sources. trigger: The user must release mana into the surrounding area and learn to interpret the cloud. limit: It uses a large quantity of mana. The information is rudimentary, and detecting weak sources takes practice; Zorian’s version lets him sense marbles as physical objects but not rank their mana emissions. interacts: It can help locate mana constructs such as magic missiles and mana-charged marbles, where unaided mana sense would struggle. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:017:p101]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:020:p54]
unmatched.note: Mana-intensive exhaustion training (A mage using the method). Kind other; Repeatedly casting mana-intensive spells until personal reserves are exhausted accelerates their growth. The accelerated growth disrupts the mage’s shaping control, which the soul ordinarily protects by limiting the pace of growth. trigger: The mage must continually exhaust their reserves with mana-intensive spells. limit: Wrecks shaping skills; artificially increasing reserves also causes loss of control, and the lines say it is essentially impossible to increase reserves without bad side effects. interacts: Greater mana reserves trade off against shaping control and can make finesse-focused spells impossible for people with sufficiently high natural reserves. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:020:p54]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:001:p101]
unmatched.note: Mana-keyed housing lock (Academy housing system). Kind rule-imposing; The door lock is keyed to a mage’s personal mana: channeling that mana into the key activates it so it can unlock the door. trigger: The user must channel their personal mana into the key. limit: The lines do not specify other limits. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:001:p101]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: concept-law.

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:091:p58]
unmatched.note: mana manipulation (Zorian). Kind other; Zorian directs mana along the sides of a sealed scroll to make the seal detach without resistance. trigger: He must direct mana along the seal. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:091:p58]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:049:p8]
unmatched.note: mana perception (Zorian). Kind other; Zorian senses his own mana flow while performing magic, allowing him to detect and correct small flaws in his technique. trigger: Requires using mana perception while doing magic; Zorian’s ability is still rudimentary. limit: He has not mastered even its basic forms. interacts: Helps stabilize his unstructured levitation by revealing flaws he can correct. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:049:p8]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:001:p149], [mother_of_learning:036:p6]
unmatched.note: Mana shaping (Zorian). Kind other; Zorian directly manipulates objects and water with mana, levitating them and changing their arrangement or shape. He can also control water this way, though it is much harder than controlling solid objects. trigger: Requires sustained control and shaping skill; shaping disruption makes it harder. limit: Complex constructs strain his control, which degrades over time; water is especially difficult to control, and he eventually loses control of the marbles during a rapid sequence of shape changes. interacts: The train’s shaping disruption ward interferes with his control but does not prevent him from performing the shaping. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:001:p149]], named in 2 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:001:p172]
unmatched.note: Mana-shaping exercise (Zorian). Kind other; Zorian uses raw mana manipulation to levitate an apple over his palm; the passage describes this as an exercise in controlling and directing magical energy, rather than a spell. trigger: Zorian manipulates mana to form a construct that holds the apple aloft. limit: Mastering the exercise took Zorian two years. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:001:p172]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:047:p87]
unmatched.note: Mana-signature testing (The stone orb; Xvim uses it to test Zorian). Kind other; When mana is channeled into the orb, it glows according to the user’s personal mana signature, allowing Xvim to check identity against the signature on record. A person can hide or alter their own signature, but Xvim says they cannot mimic another person’s. trigger: The subject channels mana into the orb. limit: A false positive may be possible through tampering, but Xvim says he can detect that. interacts: It distinguishes a person’s signature from another’s, but does not by itself prevent someone from hiding or changing their signature. shown by character-explains [demonstration [mother_of_learning:047:p87]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:088:p99]
unmatched.note: Mana-siphoning stones (Silverlake). Kind other; Paired stones draw ambient mana from the Dungeon and convey it to stones in Silverlake's hideout, powering her pocket dimension. trigger: The paired stones must be linked between the Dungeon and the hideout. limit: Damaging the Dungeon-side stones would cut off the mana supply and cause the pocket dimension to fall apart. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:088:p99]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:091:p135]
unmatched.note: manifesting claws (Nochka). Kind other; Nochka manifests claws and uses them to clamp down on Kirielle’s arm. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:091:p135]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:103:p17]
unmatched.note: manifold resonance spell (Zorian and his team). Kind power-interaction; It bypasses mind blank by targeting the mind through its connections to the body and soul, rather than trying to contact the sealed-off mind directly. On touch, it causes the targets’ bodies to go limp and lets Zorian plunge them into a constructed dream world. trigger: Requires skin-to-skin contact and three minds to cast it. limit: It is complicated and hard to control. Repeated use on the same target makes them instinctively resist it after a handful of attempts; highly trained targets may resist after two or three. interacts: It works despite the targets keeping their mind blank spells active. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:103:p17]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: power-interaction.

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:103:p23]
unmatched.note: marble (Zorian). Kind other; When activated, it sucks in the surrounding air and creates a sizeable area of total vacuum; the rush of air back into the area drags nearby people toward its center. trigger: It activates when dropped. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:103:p23]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:090:p20]
unmatched.note: marker connection (Zorian and Zach). Kind other; A ritual taps into their identical soul-markers to detect the other marker and establish a connection across a great distance. Zorian can use the connection to touch Zach’s soul and jolt him awake. trigger: The markers must remain embedded in both souls; Zorian performs the long-range ritual. limit: Bridging the distance is difficult and costly in mana; without the identical markers, the connection would be impossible. It cannot carry a conversation. shown by demonstrated [narrator [mother_of_learning:090:p20]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:067:p105]
unmatched.note: Marker connection to the orb (Zorian). Kind power-interaction; Zorian uses his marker to connect to the dimensional anchor he has identified as the orb. The connection collapses the deployed pocket dimension into a glass globe that materializes in his hand. trigger: Zorian focuses the marker on the dimensional anchor; it takes several attempts before he succeeds. interacts: The marker lets Zorian identify the anchor as the orb and interact with its deployed form. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:067:p105]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: power-interaction.

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:061:p200]
unmatched.note: Marker contingency (The marker woven through Zach’s soul; Zorian’s corresponding marker has this function disabled.). Kind rule-imposing; It monitors the Controller’s mind and soul for ‘significant tampering’ and terminates the current restart when it detects it. In Zach’s case, it treated Alanic’s attempt to separate his soul from his body as an attack. trigger: Detection of significant tampering with the Controller’s mind or soul; soul separation is enough to trigger it. limit: It ends the current restart. The exact threshold for significant tampering is unclear; Zach’s marker has the function, while Zorian’s is defective in this respect. interacts: It can interrupt soul training and restrict hostile mind or soul magic. Zorian suspects non-structured mind magic can bypass it to some extent; the text presents this as a suspicion. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:061:p200]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: concept-law.

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:053:p109]
unmatched.note: Marker’s sense for the Key (The Controller marker). Kind other; The marker can sense the presence of the Key’s pieces, helping the Controller locate them. trigger: The Key pieces are present within whatever range the marker can sense; the lines do not specify that range. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:053:p109]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:044:p43]
unmatched.note: Marker switches (Zorian’s marker). Kind other; The marker contains command switches that respond to their bearer’s probes; activating one produces an effect, and one gives Zorian an impression of its intended function. Most switches’ functions are unknown, and some do not respond. trigger: The bearer must interact with and activate a functional switch. limit: Most switches give no indication of their function; some are inert, possibly because Zorian cannot use them correctly or because they were damaged during transfer. shown by character-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:044:p43]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:030:p114]
unmatched.note: Marker tracking ritual (A caster possessing a copy of the marker; Zorian casts the modified version). Kind other; A ten-minute ritual uses a marker copy as its search reference and gives the caster the location and distance of matching markers within a broad area. Zorian’s version was modified to search for markers stamped on souls rather than on a keystone. trigger: The caster must perform the ritual with the appropriate marker reference; Zorian’s modified ritual requires a marker on a soul as its target. limit: It consumes a large amount of mana and has a wide but finite range. interacts: A marker copy can serve as the search reference, but locating a soul-stamped marker requires modifying the ritual; tracking by marker is described as almost impossible without the maker’s original keystone or a nearby willing focus. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:030:p114]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:031:p141]
unmatched.note: marker tracking spell (Zorian). Kind other; The ritual gives Zorian a sense of the locations of individuals bearing markers relative to himself. Repeating it lets him detect changes in their positions. trigger: The individuals must bear markers, and Zorian must perform the ritual. limit: The passage does not specify its detection range or other limits. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:031:p141]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:019:p169]
unmatched.note: Matriarch’s control of the giant worm (The matriarch). Kind power-interaction; The matriarch controls the giant worm, which attacks anything that tries to sneak up on her and Zorian. The worm had earlier been attacking the group independently, but was still under her control after she appeared. trigger: The lines show it acting as a guard for the matriarch and Zorian; the means of establishing control is not described. interacts: The worm’s attacks protect the matriarch and Zorian from approaching threats. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:019:p169]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: power-interaction.

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:016:p52]
unmatched.note: Matriarch's sound illusion (Aranea matriarch). Kind other; The matriarch creates actual sound waves that imitate speech, rather than directly implanting a mental illusion. interacts: Because it acts through sound waves rather than targeting the mind, Kael's mind-shield spell does not protect him from it. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:016:p52]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:071:p81]
unmatched.note: Memory bank (The orb of the first emperor; usable by the Controller). Kind other; A Controller can focus on memories and push them into an internal bank, where they remain available across restarts until deleted. trigger: The Controller must focus on the memories to store them; the Guardian says the empty space can be sensed by focusing on the Key piece correctly. limit: The bank has a limit, though it is far beyond what a Controller is likely to reach. Its stored memories are destroyed when the time loop ends and reality permanently collapses. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:071:p81]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:062:p34]
unmatched.note: Memory erasure (Aranean elders). Kind other; Aranean elders can erase their own memories of important secrets so that mind-readers cannot obtain that information from them. trigger: The elders choose to erase the relevant memories. limit: The lines describe this as applying to their own memories; no further limits are stated. interacts: It frustrates attempts to obtain secrets by reading their minds. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:062:p34]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:042:p145]
unmatched.note: memory magic (The aranea, including Memory of Sublime Glories; Zorian is learning it). Kind other; An aranea can enter another person's mind to inspect thoughts and memories. Memory of Sublime Glories examines the memory packet in Zorian’s mind and assesses its condition. trigger: Zorian must open his mind to allow a closer examination. limit: The passage does not state a precise limit; Zorian is wary of allowing someone to tinker deeply with his mind. shown by demonstrated [demonstration [mother_of_learning:042:p145]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:089:p34]
unmatched.note: Memory manipulation abilities (Zorian). Kind other; Zorian can modify people’s memories. Xvim says he can use this as a limited retry button when trying to convince someone, by modifying their memory and trying again. limit: It is described as a limited retry; the lines do not specify further limits. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:089:p34]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:076:p57], [mother_of_learning:095:p133], [mother_of_learning:091:p169]
unmatched.note: memory modification (Zach’s simulacrum and Zorian). Kind other; Zach’s simulacrum changes Kael’s and his daughter’s memories so they believe the academy arranged their relocation. Zorian and Zach also modify the healer’s memory so it cannot contradict Zach’s cover story. trigger: The target must have a memory that can be modified. shown by narrator-explains [narrator [mother_of_learning:076:p57]], named in 3 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked).

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:016:p28]
unmatched.note: Memory packet (Aranea matriarch; Zorian receives it). Kind power-transfer; The matriarch places a packet of memories inside Zorian's mind for him to carry across restarts and later deliver to her reborn self. A mind-magic specialist later confirms it is dormant, but cannot verify that it contains only memories. trigger: Zorian agrees to the matriarch's terms and undergoes her procedure; the packet is meant to be delivered to her in a later restart. limit: The packet is said to last at least a year. Its contents and any possible hidden effects are not confirmed. interacts: A mind-magic specialist can detect that it is dormant but cannot determine whether it contains only memories. shown by character-explains [character_claim [mother_of_learning:016:p28]], named in 1 chunk(s) (Luna, unchecked). Missing: power-transfer.

unmatched.source: Mother of Learning batch read 2026-11-18; chunk locators [mother_of_learning:023:p25], [mother_of_learning:037:p105], [mother_of_learning:092:p12]
